description: This file defines the DeleteMultipleForm class in Drupal, which provides a confirmation form for deleting multiple entities, including handling translations, permissions, and user interactions.

classes.name: DeleteMultipleForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for confirming and processing the deletion of multiple entities, including handling translations and permissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies like current user, entity type manager, temp store, and messenger.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getBaseFormId
methods.description: Returns the base form ID string.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the dynamic form ID based on entity type.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Generates the confirmation question for deletion.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Provides URL to redirect if operation is canceled.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, loads entities, and prepares confirmation details.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, deletes entities/translations, logs actions, and sets messages.

methods.name: getDeletedMessage
methods.description: Returns a message indicating how many items were deleted.

methods.name: getInaccessibleMessage
methods.description: Returns a message for items that could not be deleted due to permissions.

methods.description: Checks if the form is safe within a workspace context.
